boundaries.reason: Agent configuration, approval policies, hooks and the project dispatcher changed or added since 0.30.0 survive a release rollback.
boundaries.recovery: Stop agent sessions before rollback. After rollback, back up the listed files, remove only Subyard-managed approval hook and policy files, restore the target release's agent configuration and project dispatcher, and run yard init in each affected yard before restarting agents. Preserve operator-owned content.

boundaries.reason: Split Claude approval drop-ins remain active after rollback; Codex approval fragments survive but are inert in 0.31.0.
boundaries.recovery: Stop agent sessions before rollback. After rollback, back up and remove only the listed Subyard-managed files in each affected yard, then run yard init before restarting agents. Preserve operator-owned policies and account for custom installation paths.

boundaries.reason: Managed Claude instructions added after 0.32.0 remain active after rollback. Releases through 0.32.0 copy host instruction files to the agent instruction paths and refuse a file or link at these paths, such as a link from a user-dotfiles install script.
boundaries.recovery: Before rollback, run yard -Y NAME profile disable user-dotfiles in each yard that uses it, which runs uninstall.sh from its dotfiles clone when there is one and keeps the clone, then move any file or link left at these paths away. After rollback, back up and remove /etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md in each affected yard if its rule is unwanted, run yard init, then restart agent sessions. Account for custom installation paths.
